scheme2_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Crop insurance protecting farmers against loss of farm produce from natural disasters, pests, and diseases.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Life insurance protecting bank account holders and their families against death by any cause.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Varies by crop and location; specific sum insured decided at enrollment (covers actual crop loss).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Fixed Rs. 2 lakh one-time payout for death of the covered person.

comparisons.scheme1_value: All farmers (including tenant farmers and sharecroppers) growing notified crops in notified areas.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Any person aged 18–50 with a bank account or post office account.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Affordable: Farmers pay max 2% for Kharif food/oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops. Government subsidizes the rest; North-East, J&K, and Himachal Pradesh get 100% government payment.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Fixed Rs. 436 per year (about Rs. 36 per month).

comparisons.scheme1_value: No age restriction mentioned; any farmer of any age can apply.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Must be between 18 and 50 years old.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Photo, bank passbook, ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/NREGA card), address proof, and land records (RoR/LPC or land tenure agreement).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Filled Consent-cum-Declaration form, self-attested KYC (Aadhaar/Voter ID/MGNREGA card/Driving Licence), active bank/post office account, and nominee details.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online at pmfby.gov.in (register as guest farmer, fill form, upload documents, make payment). Also available offline via CSC.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Offline: download form from jansuraksha.gov.in, fill, sign, attach KYC, submit to bank/post office. Online: many banks allow enrolment via net banking or mobile banking.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Must apply within ~2 weeks of the start of sowing season (exact cut-off dates notified per state/season on pmfby.gov.in). Missing this means no cover for that season. [RED FLAG]
comparisons.scheme2_value: No strict seasonal deadline. Enrollment is year-round, but cover runs 1 June to 31 May; annual auto-debit renewal happens automatically.

comparisons.scheme1_value: [RED] Losses in non-notified areas not covered. [RED] Missing seasonal cut-off = no cover. [YELLOW] Losses from negligence or non-compliance with recommended practices excluded. [YELLOW] Post-harvest cover only 14 days.
comparisons.scheme2_value: [RED] 30-day waiting period: natural death in first 30 days not covered (accidental death covered from day one). [YELLOW] Can enrol through only one bank account. [YELLOW] Cover lapses if sufficient balance not maintained for auto-debit.

comparisons.scheme1_value: One crop season (typically 4–6 months depending on crop type and sowing season).
comparisons.scheme2_value: One year (1 June to 31 May), renewable annually as long as premium is paid.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Claims targeted within two months of harvest; uses satellite imaging, drones, and mobile apps for loss estimation.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Not specified in provided documents; contact toll-free: 1800-180-1111 or 1800-110-001.

key_differences_summary: PMFBY protects farm income from crop losses and is seasonal; PMJJBY protects families with a lump-sum death benefit and runs year-round. PMFBY requires land records and notified area eligibility; PMJJBY only needs a bank account and age 18–50. PMFBY has strict seasonal deadlines; PMJJBY has an annual auto-debit cycle.
recommendation: These are two different schemes for different needs. Choose PMFBY if you are a farmer to protect your crops. Choose PMJJBY if you want affordable life insurance to protect your family. You can enroll in BOTH if you are a farmer with a bank account and age 18–50. **Disclaimer: This is AI guidance based on official scheme documents and not an official government notification. For final decisions, visit pmfby.gov.in or jansuraksha.gov.in or contact your nearest bank/post office.**
